74.desc:
Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher
-------------
Breakwater Small Batch is a series of limited releases created to bring you closer to our strain selection process. This project gives you the opportunity to explore strains that are still being evaluated for large scale production. Some of these strains may even return to our menu.
-------------
Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different.

Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole.

485.desc:
Breakwater's RSO is a potent, full spectrum extract created to capture the plant’s complete range of beneficial compounds. Pioneered by Rick Simpson, RSO (Rick Simpson Oil) gained acclaim as he attributed his recovery from basal cell carcinoma to its use and began sharing his discovery publicly. His work helped propel global awareness and advocacy for the medicinal potential of cannabis. 

Breakwater's CBD-Rich RSO is crafted to offer potency, clarity, and control. The balanced cannabinoid ratio allows THC to deliver its well known benefits, such as pain relief, appetite support, and mood elevation – while CBD works alongside it to help moderate intensity and contribute its own medicinal properties, including anti-inflammatory and calming effects. This synergy of cannabinoids interact in a way that many users describe as more stable, more manageable, and more sustainable for regular use. Robust relief and reduced psychoactivity make this ideal for those who are sensitive to THC but still want a meaningful, full spectrum RSO experience.

RSO can be ingested or applied topically. Due to the oil’s thick consistency, it should NOT be dabbed, smoked, or inhaled via vaporization or other methods. One of the most popular and effective ways to take RSO is through sublingual administration – placing it under the tongue. Please note that this is a very potent product, and we highly recommend discussing dosage and administration with a budtender if you are new to RSO.

-------------

Helpful For: Depression, Pain, Muscle Tension, Fatigue, Insomnia, Nausea

-------------

Whole Plant. Fresh Frozen. Solventless. Live Hash Rosin.

-------------

Mass Super Skunk x Sour Diesel Bx3

-------------

Fruit-forward cannabis strains have dominated the market in the current cannabis climate, often at the expense of other flavors. However, at Breakwater, our cultivators are passionate about exploring this plant’s limitless diversity, relentlessly seeking out flavors of times past that speak to the complex history of cannabis. For this reason, Sour Super Skunk is a meaningful selection for us, preserving and expressing its own unique chapter in that history.

If there is one thing East Coast cannabis has been recognized for, it’s the gas profiles and Sour varieties. Sour Super Skunk, from Top Dawg Seeds, evokes memories of 1990s NYC and the age of Sour and Skunk. We carefully combed through nearly a thousand seeds with a Sour lineage before finally landing on this stalwart classic. Nose-hair-tingling, eye-burning, mouth-watering, sulphury sour and skunk aromas are in full effect with this phenotype. These aromas bring us back to a time when cannabis was still outlawed and heavily stigmatized. As such, quality Sour and Skunk varietals have been hard to track down. Critical genetic preservation has made it possible to rediscover plants that some have sworn were lost forever. We thank JJ of Top Dawg for this valuable contribution.

Large, chunky Sour Diesel shaped buds fill the canopy and the air with acrid tartness. The cured flower releases notes of gas, sour, and a gentle sweetness. Back-alley New York City terps smack you in the face as soon as the lid lifts from the jar. The live hash rosin packs its own unique punch with all the sour and skunk one could need. Effects are versatile and can range from uplifting and energizing to heavy-eyed, couch-locking, sedative effects–depending on the person, mood, and time of day.
